newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ TREASURY APPOINTS MARK PREBBLE ACTING SECRETARY.
newsitem.headline: NZ TREASURY APPOINTS MARK PREBBLE ACTING SECRETARY.

text.p: Treasury official Mark Prebble has been appointed acting Secretary to the New Zealand Treasury to replace Murray Horn, State Services Commissioner Michael Wintringham said on Friday.
Wintringham said Prebble would remain in the job until a permanent Secretary was appointed.
The post would be advertised in New Zealand and overseas in early September.

Prebble, 46, is currently branch manager of the budget management branch of Treasury. He has been a public servant for 20 years and has a PhD in public policy from Victoria University in Wellington. His brother is Act New Zealand leader Richard Prebble.
Horn is to take up a senior post with the ANZ Banking Group in Melbourne.
